name: Precinct Three: The Zoo Keeper
source:
Igor is feeling a little sad that he has no one to call his own. Trying to cheer him up, Hugo takes him to get love advice from some familiar faces.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
伊戈爾有點難過，身邊連個能稱作自己另一半的人都沒有。雨果想哄他開心，便帶他去向幾個老熟人討教戀愛訣竅。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
